exposure: hospital type (Social Security Institution contract vs. private financing)
cohort: The study analyzed data from 11,885 births occurring between 2015 and 2020 in two private hospitals in Istanbul, Turkiye.
finding: Overall, 73.7% of deliveries were by Cesarean section, a rate that declined from 78.9% in 2015 to 69.7% in 2020, and was significantly associated with higher maternal age and fewer antenatal visits.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the private hospital operating with a Social Security Institution (SGK) contract (77.9%) compared to the hospital serving only with private financing.
